about_the_game:
• Three vivid and kinetic comic book stories revealing the back stories of three key characters of Slave Zero X, written & directed by legendary comic book creators Anthony Williams and Andy Lanning of Ideas & Inks.

  • Over 100 pages of previously unreleased artwork by Poppy Works' Slave Zero X art team, including concept art, in-game assets, and promotional art.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains animated depictions of violent and gory content that may not be appropriate for all audiences.
